name: smwgraphics-super-smash-bros-styled-fire-flower
title: Super Smash Bros. Styled Fire Flower
description:
A Fire Flower replacement inspired by it's appearance in the original Super Smash Bros., which also resembles it's sprite from Super Mario Bros.

While not required, I would recommend using this tweak alongside this graphic, otherwise the shading on the stem will keep mirroring itself.
